scope: For every O1-C07 account, what must be KNOWN before launch, what must merely have a MEASUREMENT MECHANISM before launch, what is expected/budgeted versus measured, whether an exact count, maximum, floor or configuration is required, who owns the number or decision, and what happens if the value is unknowable before execution.

stage_definitions.definition: Before any warrant exists. Governs what may lawfully be decided, filled or signed at all.
The act of binding the exact instrument: locators, execution surface, per-source accounting values, approvals, signature.
After issuance, before the governed process starts. Governs what must be FROZEN versus merely AVAILABLE.
The governed run itself. Governs what is MEASURED and what happens on breach.
Publication of measured counts, retained evidence and the return accounting.
Independent review, adjudication and adoption or rejection.

obligation_primitives_used_throughout.KNOWN: an exact value must exist and be fixed before the stage ends
obligation_primitives_used_throughout.MECHANISM: the means to obtain the value later must itself be fixed and verified before the stage ends; the value need not exist yet
obligation_primitives_used_throughout.MEASURED: the value is obtained during the governed run and retained
obligation_primitives_used_throughout.POLICY_CEILING: an HQ-adopted maximum whose purpose is to STOP a run; not a claim about expected or historical behaviour

S0_pre_warrant_pre_issuance.KNOWN: That the account is mandatory and separate. This is already fixed by frozen O1-C07 and Omega-1.
S0_pre_warrant_pre_issuance.owner: OMEGA / frozen law; no worker discretion
S0_pre_warrant_pre_issuance.note: No worker may defer, waive or reinterpret the existence of this account at this stage.

S1_warrant_issuance.KNOWN: A per-source path_opens value AND its basis, if the C4B per-source slot is carried forward. C4B's token is REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_AND_BASIS, so both parts are issuance-time obligations.
S1_warrant_issuance.MECHANISM: The instrument that would produce the count must be identified and bound at issuance, otherwise the slot cannot be lawfully filled.
S1_warrant_issuance.owner: HQ (binding) with the C4 execution owner (supplying the basis)
S1_warrant_issuance.BLOCKER: HQ194 has accepted that the bound runtime can neither measure nor enforce this count. Therefore at issuance the value CANNOT be lawfully produced.
S1_warrant_issuance.discontinuity: DQ-01 — the adopted candidate carries no per-source slot, so under the adopted candidate's own shape there is no per-source slot into which this value must be entered.

S2_pre_launch.KNOWN: Per Omega-1's acceptance, the EXPECTED BUDGET and the INSTRUMENTATION must be frozen here.
S2_pre_launch.why: No frozen artifact supplies an expected path-opens figure for any permitted source. O1-C07's SRC27 hardened note gives only an account-term FLOOR and warns that multiple path-level opens occur. Deriving a number would be inventing a count.
S2_pre_launch.why_instrumentation: No lawful unprivileged interposition mechanism exists on the bound surface (HQ192 Part A, accepted by HQ194).
S2_pre_launch.consequence: This stage CANNOT be completed lawfully for this account on the current runtime.

S3_during_execution.MEASURED: The literal OS path-open count, with its basis.
S3_during_execution.why: The count occurs inside pyreadstat's compiled extension and is not observable from Python; DYLD interposition fails on the bound surface. Zero observations are a MECHANISM FAILURE, established by a direct libc.open control that also produced zero, and are NOT evidence of zero opens.
S3_during_execution.owner: C4 execution owner (would own the measurement if a mechanism existed)

S4_return_accounting_publication.KNOWN: Publication must state the account's value WITH its basis.
S4_return_accounting_publication.explicitly_forbidden: A fabricated zero, and equally a fabricated count, a relabelled reader-invocation count, or a relabelled Python-level open count.
S4_return_accounting_publication.owner: C4 execution owner publishes; HQ adjudicates

S5_post_run_review_adoption.decision: Whether an unpopulated mandatory account blocks adoption. This is an adjudication decision, not a worker decision.
S5_post_run_review_adoption.owner: HQ, and Astra/Omega if the O1-C07 grain itself is reinterpreted

S2_pre_launch.why: HQ192 measured and governed a Python-level whole-file hash pass; this is an ordinary, observable, enforceable operation in the frozen reader closure.

S2_pre_launch.note: Distinguish this from path-level opens: an existence/access CHECK performed by the reader is not the same quantity as an OS path-level open, and conflating them is the specific error this account set exists to prevent.

S2_pre_launch.KNOWN: expected budget = 1 for SRC08 and SRC12, 0 elsewhere

S3_during_execution.enforcement: excess read refused BEFORE execution; measured 1 operation per decode returning 176 bytes (SAV) or 512 (DTA)

S3_during_execution.note: HQ191 used this as the measurement layer of record and demonstrated abort BEFORE the unauthorised operation.

accounts.caveat: A decoder-invocation count is a DIFFERENT account from a path-open count and may not be reported as one.

S2_pre_launch.KNOWN: the exact selected variable set and ordinals, all frozen

S3_during_execution.MEASURED: SELECTED-VARIABLE EXACTNESS is real and enforced by higher-layer exactness assertions; a selected-read COUNT as a decoder-layer operation does NOT exist
S3_during_execution.finding: SEL-02 — usecols occurs zero times across the whole 23-module closure; all three reader sites are whole-file or metadata-only
S3_during_execution.lawful_reporting: report selected-variable exactness as a satisfied configuration/exactness account, and report any selected-read COUNT as null with a typed reason rather than fabricating a count for an operation the decoder never performs

frozen_values.SRC27: one governed fresh full Route-B pass (workload-constrained, expected 1, max 1)

S2_pre_launch.note: SRC27's value is a WORKLOAD constraint; O1-C07 expressly forbids reading it as an access constraint of one open.

accounts.frozen_expectation_available: not as a count; the qualifier 'where measurable' is load-bearing

S3_during_execution.MEASURED: PARTIAL — Python-level byte accounting is observable and exact (763 bytes SAV decode, 2629 bytes DTA decode); compiled-reader internal bytes are NOT observable (BYT-02, depends on the OSL-01 blocker)
S3_during_execution.lawful_reporting: the 'where measurable' qualifier permits reporting the measurable Python-level bytes exactly while reporting the compiled-reader interior as null with a typed reason. It does NOT permit reporting a compiled-reader byte figure as zero.

frozen_values.frozen_maximum: ZERO retries across all eight sources

S3_during_execution.note: a retry may not change source, encoding, variables, operations or authority

accounts.account: WVS/SRC35 fresh source opens and excluded-source fresh opens

S3_during_execution.MEASURED: enforceable as an absence-of-access assertion at any layer, because the required value is zero and SRC35 is a retained comparator replayed from retained material

accounts.zero_budget_discipline: a single non-zero count is a STOP condition, not a reportable variance

matrix_conclusions.conclusion: Of the ten mandatory separate accounts, eight are satisfiable on the current runtime, one (header-prefix) is closed at the Python layer by HQ194, one (byte counts) is partial by the express design of its 'where measurable' qualifier, and exactly ONE — path-level opens with its basis — is unsatisfiable at any layer available without new authority.

The unsatisfiable account is unsatisfiable at THREE consecutive stages independently: its value cannot be KNOWN at issuance, its EXPECTED budget cannot be KNOWN pre-launch, and its MEASUREMENT MECHANISM cannot be MECHANISM-available pre-launch. This is not a single missing number; it is a missing capability that removes the number from every stage at once.

The selected-column COUNT account (SEL-02) is a genuine second gap but is materially narrower: its CONFIGURATION half is fully frozen and its exactness is enforced, so only a decoder-layer COUNT is missing, and the lawful reporting route is a typed null rather than a fabricated count. It does not drive the disposition and should not be bundled with the OS-open blocker as though equally severe.

Ownership of the DECISION about the unsatisfiable account never sits with the execution owner at any stage. The C4 execution owner owns measurement and publication; Omega-1 and HQ own the account's existence and any reinterpretation of its grain; Astra is implicated only if the grain itself is changed. No stage of this matrix permits the execution owner to settle the account by choosing a proxy.

If the count is unknowable before execution — which is the actual situation — the frozen law already dictates the reporting form: null WITH A TYPED REASON, never a fabricated zero and never a relabelled proxy. The obligation does not become discretionary; it becomes a typed absence.
